hero_desc: AI-powered job hunting platform · Resume parsing · Smart optimization · Job matching · Interview prep. From upload to offer, one workspace to get it done.
hero_input_placeholder: Upload your resume, let AI find the best match...
hero_supported_formats: Supports PDF · Word · LinkedIn export · No registration needed
peek_subtitle: One workspace for resume parsing, optimization, matching and interview prep
features_desc: From resume import to offer in hand, ResuMuse covers every key milestone. Let AI be your personal career advisor.
feature_parse_desc: Upload PDF / Word, AI auto-extracts all content, identifies experience, skills, education — done in seconds with 99.2% accuracy.
feature_editor_desc: Monaco-level content editor with real-time AI suggestions to make every bullet more impactful and data-driven.
feature_chat_desc: Multi-turn Q&A about your resume with source citations — not generic advice, but deep understanding of your career background.
feature_match_desc: Paste any JD, get match score + radar chart + gap analysis + prioritized rewrite suggestions — know exactly what to improve.
feature_interview_desc: Generate behavioral, product, strategy, and technical questions from your actual resume, with well-sourced reference answers.
feature_version_desc: Save multiple resume variants for different roles, diff any two versions, roll back anytime — apply with confidence.
